fieldNotes.location: COULD NOT POSITIVELY CONFIRM the building. Roster address '5500 Watson Rd, Arlington TX 76018' is incorrect: it geocoded (RANGE_INTERPOLATED) into a residential subdivision near a highway, not an industrial site. Web research consistently identifies the real Frito-Lay Arlington plant as '948 Avenue H E, Arlington TX 76011' — listed as 'Frito-Lay Inc - Dip Plant', production began 1971, ~80 employees (Yelp, Cylex, PotatoPro, D&B).
fieldNotes.search: Surveyed the Arlington avenue/industrial corridor along the Union Pacific rail NE of downtown (the district where the lettered avenues run) at z16-z17 satellite and multiple Street View headings. The corridor contains many small/medium industrial buildings; no single building presents an unmistakable Frito-Lay manufacturing signature (rooftop process equipment, large dock bank, trailer drop yard). The plant is small and old, consistent with a dip/salsa facility rather than a large potato-chip plant, which makes it hard to distinguish from neighboring industrial tenants from overhead imagery.
fieldNotes.coords: Placeholder coords (32.7370, -97.0915) point to the general Avenue H E industrial corridor and should NOT be treated as the plant center.
fieldNotes.recommendation: Needs human review: obtain a verified street address / parcel for the Frito-Lay Arlington (Avenue H E) plant before auditing. Note this is a small legacy facility (~80 employees) and may have limited yard infrastructure.
